summary: Verified new admin gate UX: GUEST /admin shows 'Huna ruhusa ya admin' with testID='admin-login' ('Ingia kama Admin') button and 'Rudi Nyumbani' ghost button. Tapping admin-login navigates to /(auth)/login. Admin login (admin@vibe.app / Vibe@2026) succeeds and /admin renders full Admin Dashboard (admin-tab-overview + stat-users visible; gate not shown). A freshly-registered normal user visiting /admin sees the gate WITHOUT the admin-login button (isGuest gates it correctly) and 'Rudi Nyumbani' navigates back to home. Backend regression: POST /api/auth/login admin with 'Vibe@2026' -> 200 role=admin, empty pw -> 200; GET /api/admin/stats no-token -> 401, customer token -> 403, admin token -> 200. No regressions detected.
critical_code_review_comments: admin/index.tsx gate is clean: guest branch renders primary CTA (admin-login) and ghost CTA (Rudi Nyumbani); non-guest branch renders only ghost CTA. isGuest destructured from useAuth as documented in the change note.

Primary button uses Pressable with COLORS.primary + white text (good contrast) and 48px height (>=44 touch target). Ghost text button is only ~SPACING.md vertical padding – still tappable but visually subtle; acceptable per design intent.
